channel.description: Latest articles from Al-Jazeera Media Network (aljazeera.com)

item.title: No evidence to support US claim China conducted nuclear blast test: Monitor
item.description: US wants Beijing to join a revised nuclear weapons treaty after expiration of a previous accord between US and Russia.

item.title: Israel’s war on Gaza decimated transport and even made walking perilous
item.description: Total losses of transport infrastructure estimated at $2.5bn. leaving many areas isolated and basic services suspended.

item.title: Japan snap election: Who’s standing and what’s at stake?
item.description: Japanese are voting on issues ranging from cost of living to constitutional reform.

item.title: Bangladesh election: Who are the key players and parties?
item.description: The country heads to the polls on February 12. Here are the parties and individuals who could shape the outcome.

item.title: European Union says video app TikTok must change ‘addictive’ design
item.description: TikTok calls European Commission probe 'meritless', pledges to challenge findings the video platform harms minors.

item.title: Why US-funded vaccine trial plan for babies in Guinea-Bissau caused outrage
item.description: The health trial by researchers at the University of Southern Denmark has been suspended by Bissau-Guinean authorities.

item.title: Trump’s ‘Board of Peace’ to convene in Washington, discuss Gaza: Report
item.description: Report by news outlet Axios says that first meeting of board tasked with governing Gaza will take place on February 19.

item.title: LIVE: Iran’s top diplomat set to address Al Jazeera Forum in Doha
item.description: Today's event will discuss Israel's genocidal war on Gaza and the state of the Arab world.

item.title: How Basant became Lahore’s signature festival in Pakistan
item.description: After years of restrictions, Lahore cautiously celebrates the return of its iconic spring kite festival.

item.title: Vanishing wildlife at Egypt’s Lake Qarun force fishermen to abandon trade
item.description: Toxic waters of Lake Qarun devastate fishermen's livelihoods, leaving boats idle and restaurants empty along its shores.
